brief: 6 productivity tips from a designer who built a 7-figure studio.

slots.headline: Six Productivity Habits That Scaled My Design Studio to Seven Figures

slots.title: Block Deep Work
slots.body: Protect three uninterrupted hours every morning for your most complex creative tasks. Email and Slack can wait until after lunch. This single shift doubled my output without adding hours.

slots.title: Batch Admin Tasks
slots.body: Group all meetings, invoicing, and emails into two dedicated afternoons per week. Context switching kills creative momentum faster than any deadline. Batching keeps your mind in design mode longer.

slots.title: Template Your Workflow
slots.body: Build reusable templates for proposals, contracts, and brand presentations. You are not being lazy; you are buying back future hours. Standardization is the secret weapon of every scalable studio.

slots.title: Filter Client Intake
slots.body: Not every project deserves your calendar. Create a short qualification checklist to screen leads before the first call. Saying no to the wrong work creates space for the right revenue.

slots.title: Hire Before Ready
slots.body: Bring on support the moment you can afford it, not when you are drowning. A part-time assistant or junior designer preserves your energy for high-value strategy. Growth stalls when the founder becomes the bottleneck.

slots.title: Manage Your Energy
slots.body: Productivity is not about hours; it is about focused energy. Track your peak performance windows and schedule creative work accordingly. Rest is a business strategy, not a reward.

slots.headline: Productivity Is Your Profit Engine
